name: Flourish Financial
description: The Flourish MCP Server empowers financial advisors to securely explore client data and unlock insights directly within Claude. Access client details, manage invitations, and review account information. By connecting Flourish with Claude, you can accelerate routine analysis, streamline client meeting prep, and support recurring tasks. Permission-based access ensures that client information is protected while giving firms the power of AI-driven discovery.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Flourish Financial to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Flourish Financial to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://www.flourish.com/api/mcp/v2.0. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Flourish Financial MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Flourish Financial provides these MCP tools: flourish_get_me, flourish_get_pending_invitations, flourish_get_rates, flourish_get_user, flourish_invite_user, flourish_list_users, flourish_search_users_by_email, flourish_search_users_by_id, and flourish_search_users_by_name.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Flourish Financial?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Flourish Financial in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does Flourish Financial MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Flourish Financial requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Flourish Financial is developed by Flourish. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
